name: movies-ticket-booking-mern
description: MERN Stack Movie Ticket Booking with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Email OTP Auth, and Admin/User portals

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
